summary: This round completed four additional experiment blocks (E10, E10b, E6b, E11) and a consolidated summary, grounded in recorded JSON/PNG outputs. The retained-rank geometry-lifted SOM decomposition was verified across full-circle and limited-aperture settings: unrestricted full-rank equivalence is vacuous, while retained-rank lifting produces a clean rank transition at r = M-2 for uniform full-circle arrays, with hidden_rank=2 and n_vis=1. Reduced lifted solvers match direct joint GN exactly wherever pose is visible at that retained rank, and freeze hidden pose directions otherwise. Transmitter-array self-calibration was reproducible for monopole and phased-dipole models, with directional dipoles escaping the L=1 monopole theta rank deficiency. The state-consistency thread remained negative: exact variable-projection/hard-state elimination did not restore principled hidden-pose recovery, and the original T_U witness remains diagnostic-only. A half-circle aperture local-minimum risk was recorded explicitly.
key_results: Full-rank unrestricted lift reproduces pose perturbation to machine precision; retained-rank r4/r6 lifts leave large irreducible residuals (r4 0.474-0.864, r6 0.354-0.686 across settings) with Q^H R orthogonality ~1e-18.
reduced_r4 matches direct to full precision in every setting; reduced_r6 also matches direct everywhere pose is visible at r6.
Canonical M=8 hidden regime reproduces: r6 has n_vis=1/hidden_rank=2 and median pose error 0.0442 vs direct 0.0158.

Completed rank transition rule for uniform full circles: hiding occurs at r = M-2. M=12 reduced_r10 median pose 0.0759 vs direct 0.00761 (hidden component 0.072); M=16 reduced_r14 median pose 0.111 vs direct 0.0148 (hidden component 0.0905).
Trailing r=M-1 and r=M are an empty-lift diagnostic: B_red collapses to ~1e-19 and reduced matches direct exactly, so genuine rank-2 hiding is confined to r=M-2.

Oracle baselines: known_pose map error 0.008-0.012 (0.00812 on half arc); known_alpha pose error ~0.0016-0.0106 on full-circle settings; wrongpose map error 0.21-1.33, confirming pose calibration is required.

Half-circle aperture is a local-minimum caveat: known_alpha reaches a spurious minimum with pose error 0.86 on all three seeds, and one reduced_r6 seed reached a spurious solution despite passing the convergence gate.
E6b: all 240/240 monopole/dipole/co-moving runs converged. Monopole L=2 tx-only theta median scales 1.45e-2 rad at 15 dB to 8.10e-4 rad at 40 dB; pose 1.52e-2 to 8.57e-4; map 4.21e-2 to 2.32e-3.

E6b transmitter-array/directional-source extension: L=3 monopole theta 3.68e-3 (20 dB), 1.17e-3 (30 dB), 3.71e-4 (40 dB); co-moving L=2 theta 1.95e-2 (20 dB) to 2.07e-3 (40 dB); phased-dipole FD max rel err 2.2e-7 at eps=1e-4; L=1 phased dipole reaches complex rank 3 with third realified SV 2.0e-4.

E11 hard state equality is also a null: vp_hard_r6 stalls at the degenerate r=6 SVD cut from p_init=0 (both seeds fail, hidden error 0.0441) or converges to a distant local minimum with hidden error 0.196 from a perturbed start.

vp_soft_r6 partially reduces the hidden freeze (hidden 0.0160 vs 0.0441) but is model-biased, not recovery: VP residual 0.0623 vs 30 dB noise ratio 0.0316, discarded-current fraction ~0.87, median map error 0.838, full-physics residual ~0.83.

The demoted state witness T_U remains diagnostic-only; exact variable-projection elimination did not restore principled hidden-pose recovery, so this is not an artifact of the auxiliary coefficient c or scalar penalty.

completed_steps: Verified the full-row-rank negative control and retained-rank decomposition across settings M=8/12/16, k=8/16, full-circle, half-circle, and 3/4-circle arcs.
Extended geom_som_core.py with receiver_angles so limited-aperture arcs could reuse existing forward/Jacobian machinery.
Ran E10 settings sweep with wrongpose, known_pose, known_alpha, direct, reduced_r4, reduced_r6 and an M=12 retained-rank ablation r=2..8; wrote JSON, plot, and run output.
Completed E10b M=12/M=16 rank transition; identified the r=M-2 hiding rule and the r=M-1,M empty-lift diagnostic.
Ran E6b robust multi-transmitter study: 240 runs across SNR 15-40 dB with 8 seeds each for L=2/L=3 monopole arrays and co-moving L=2.
Implemented and FD-validated a phased-dipole transmitter-array model and ran its self-calibration.

Ran E11 variable-projection/hard-state-equality null with c eliminated exactly via retained-current projector P(p); compared direct, reduced_r6, vp_hard_r6, vp_soft_r6 and computed linearized VP pose signature.
Generated consolidated_round3_summary.json and consolidated_round3_tables.md from the actual result JSONs.
dead_ends: The original retained-rank state witness T_U failed to discriminate good from bad pose estimates and remains diagnostic-only.
Hard r=6 variable-projection is a gauge/numerical null at p_init because the cut sits on the degenerate s6=s7 pair.
vp_soft_r6 avoids the hard-cut cone but does not produce principled hidden-pose recovery; it is model-biased with high discarded-current fraction and poor map/full-physics residual.
Half-circle aperture exposes local-minimum risk, so convergence-gate success should not be interpreted as global success in that setting.
next_steps: Add a half-circle multi-start direct/known-alpha study to characterize and mitigate the local-minimum basin.

If continuing the state thread, test only a constrained formulation enforcing the discarded-current residual below the noise level with a truly scale-normalized, analytic-Jacobian penalty; current evidence does not justify claiming it will work.
Optionally extend E10b to odd/irregular aperture angle sets to test whether the r=M-2 counting rule is specific to uniform arcs.
Keep all negative state-witness and hard/soft threshold findings visible in any paper synthesis.
